concepts.why: The presence of epidermal acanthosis, scattered necrotic keratinocytes, and band-like lymphohistiocytic infiltrate on lingual biopsy, along with the clinical presentation of whitish edematous lacy patches with erosions, are consistent with Mycosis Fungoides.

The presence of fibrinogen deposition along the basement membrane, along with the clinical presentation of painful oral erosions and whitish edematous lacy patches, are consistent with Pemphigus Vulgaris.
The presence of a type AB thymoma, decreased IgG serum level, and recurrent respiratory infections, are consistent with Thymoma-associated multiorgan autoimmunity.

The presence of a thymoma, along with the clinical presentation of painful oral erosions and whitish edematous lacy patches, and the presence of fibrinogen deposition along the basement membrane, are consistent with Paraneoplastic Pemphigus.

rationales.F01: Oral erosions are common in pemphigus vulgaris and paraneoplastic pemphigus
rationales.F05: Mediastinal mass is highly suggestive of thymoma-associated multiorgan autoimmunity
rationales.F06: Lacy, white erosive lesions are characteristic of pemphigus vulgaris and paraneoplastic pemphigus
rationales.F09: Fibrinogen deposition along basement membrane is a hallmark of pemphigus vulgaris and paraneoplastic pemphigus
rationales.F11: Type AB thymoma is a strong indicator of thymoma-associated multiorgan autoimmunity and paraneoplastic pemphigus

frontier_selector.rationale: The presence of a thymoma and oral erosions with fibrinogen deposition along the basement membrane, along with the patient's significant weight loss due to impaired intake, points towards Paraneoplastic Pemphigus as the most fitting diagnosis.
